notes.title: August 2025 Update: Development Progress & New Timeline
notes.notes:
Hello Astra Odysseans!


We're writing to you today with an important update on our development and timeline.


This project is a labor of love, and your incredible support has allowed us to raise our ambitions for what this game can truly be. We believe true craftsmanship can't be rushed. To give our ideas the time they need to mature and to integrate all the features we're excited about, we are giving the project more breathing room.

Consequently, the Beta is now planned for the end of 2025, with a full release targeted for 2026.


To show you this extra time is being put to good use, we want to share a major milestone: we have officially finalized all the core city-building gameplay mechanics for both planetside cities and space structures!

It also means we have now launched into the full-scale asset production phase. Our artists are hard at work creating the final 3D models for every building, unit, space station, megastructure, and more.

For cities, our goal was to create architectural styles versatile enough for any civilization type you choose to play. To bring this to life, we've defined several distinct styles. Here’s a first look:

Utility: A functional style defined by industrial concrete and metal. Built for efficiency and resilience.

BioShape: An organic style inspired by natural shapes, featuring flowing structures and a warm, beige color scheme.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/1ee3ccb4b65a0ccbd9479dc281fbdd3ab8e37a2f.png"]This image shows the Alloy Factory (left), the Solar Panel Field (center), and the Scientific Laboratory (right) in both styles. Other architectural styles are planned for the game's launch.



Technical Update: We are continuing to advance the game's AI/bot systems and are also finalizing the lore and quests that will make your journey unique. This july and august, we are also focusing on a significant improvements to lighting, shadows, and the game's overall atmosphere, as well as enriching the fauna and flora you will discover across all 20 biomes.



What’s Next? Our next major milestone is launching the Beta at the end of this year. If you’re interested in getting more frequent updates and want a chance to be among the first to play, we invite you to join our community on Discord!



On an exciting final note, we'll be participating in the 4X Fest on Steam next week!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/bca3622c30db3300b72a3f4018b5c5a4b603475f.png"]

Thank you for your incredible patience and continued support. We're building something we're extremely proud of, and we can't wait to share it with you.



Toward Astra and beyond!
Alex & Valentin

notes.title: Update on Beyond Astra: Galaxies Show, Beta Progress and More!
notes.notes:
Hello, We hope you’re all doing well! We've been busy working on the beta for Beyond Astra and wanted share a quick update on our progress.

Our goal with Beyond Astra is to create an immersive 4X grand strategy experience, blending elements of city-building and RTS gameplay; a game where exploration, expansion, and conquest unfold seamlessly on 3D planets and in space. This is a childhood dream we’ve been bringing to life for the past five years, pushing the limits of one of the most innovative game engines out there.

We're really grateful for all the enthusiasm you've shown for the game! A huge thank you to everyone who backed our Kickstarter campaign. Late pledges are still open if you’d like to get involved.

We're also happy to share that we received a grant from the French state to help us finish development. Every bit of funding goes directly into making Beyond Astra the best version it can be. Valentin and I are working hard every day to make that happen.

Lately, we've focused a lot on improving the user interface (UI) and overall experience. Our goal is to make everything clear and intuitive, so you can focus on your strategy. Key improvements include:

 A cleaner, easier-to-read UI for managing your empire
 Customizable city templates to simplify colony building.
 A central management interface for smoother gameplay.

We're also adding more detail to the game's visuals and gameplay: new environments, units, and creatures! Here’s a little sneak peek.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/6fd1d80206b241ab5b49b156a9cf59b8ea133e22.jpg

Speaking of showing more, we're excited to be part of the Galaxies Show on Twitch! Tune in on April 17th at 8pm UK / 9pm CEST / 12pm Pacific / 3pm Eastern. It'll be a great opportunity to reveal more visuals and give you a clearer picture of what we're aiming for with the beta.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/fa767598136660b6a3b2d8a5de4d7526c376fcfe.jpg

Because the game has changed so much, the old alpha preview doesn't really show what Beyond Astra looks like now. We'll be taking it down in the next few days. Thank you so much for all the valuable feedback you shared on the alpha, it helped us a lot!

Thanks again for your continued support and patience. We're excited for you to see everything we've been working on!

Best,
Alex & Valentin
